description: A live crypto price ticker that pulls real-time prices and 24-hour change percentages from CoinGecko's free public API (no auth required). Supports 1 to 8 configurable coins by CoinGecko ID (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, cardano, etc.). Displays each coin as a card with the official coin icon, symbol, current price in the selected fiat currency, and a 24-hour percent change badge that is green for positive and red for negative moves. Auto-refreshes on a configurable interval; when a price changes the card briefly flashes green (up) or red (down) to draw attention. Three layout modes: row (horizontal cards), grid (responsive multi-column), and ticker (horizontal scrolling marquee style). Configurable decimal precision, optional 24-hour change display, and optional animated price update flash. Graceful loading, error (with retry), and rate-limit-awareness. Inherits typography from the site and uses site color variables for background and text with sensible fallbacks. Perfect for fintech, DeFi, and crypto-native marketing sites.

props.name: id
props.description: HTML ID for targeting with CSS or JavaScript

props.name: coinIds
props.description: Comma-separated list of CoinGecko coin IDs (find them at coingecko.com/en/coins — the ID is the slug in the URL, not the symbol). Example: bitcoin,ethereum,solana,cardano

props.name: vsCurrency
props.description: Fiat currency to price the coins in, as a CoinGecko currency code (usd, eur, gbp, jpy, cad, aud, inr, brl, btc, eth, etc.)

props.name: heading
props.description: Optional heading above the ticker

props.name: subheading
props.description: Optional subheading below the main heading

props.name: showHeading
props.description: Show or hide the heading block

props.name: layout
props.description: Arrangement of coin cards

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns on desktop (grid layout only)

props.name: cardStyle
props.description: Card surface treatment

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Show each coin's official icon on its card

props.name: showSymbol
props.description: Show the ticker symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH)

props.name: showName
props.description: Show the full coin name (e.g. Bitcoin)

props.name: show24hChange
props.description: Show the 24-hour percent change badge (green up, red down)

props.name: decimals
props.description: Number of decimals to show on the price (auto-shrinks for high-value coins like BTC to 2)

props.name: refreshInterval
props.description: Auto-refresh interval in seconds (CoinGecko free tier allows ~30 req/min — use 30+ here)

props.name: animateOnUpdate
props.description: Briefly flash cards green or red when prices tick up or down

props.name: pauseWhenHidden
props.description: Pause the refresh loop when the tab is in the background (saves quota and battery)

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Text shown during the initial load

props.name: errorText
props.description: Message shown when the API call fails
props.defaultValue: Couldn't fetch crypto prices right now. Please try again shortly.

props.name: rateLimitText
props.description: Message shown when CoinGecko returns 429 (rate limited)
props.defaultValue: Too many requests. We'll back off and retry in a moment.

props.name: retryButtonText
props.description: Text on the retry button

apiIntegrations.service: CoinGecko — markets (price + 24h change + icon in a single call)

requiredParams.vs_currency: Any supported fiat or crypto currency code (usd, eur, btc, etc.)
requiredParams.ids: Comma-separated list of CoinGecko coin IDs (not symbols)
requiredParams.price_change_percentage: Must be '24h' to populate price_change_percentage_24h in the response

apiIntegrations.notes:
ONE CALL FETCHES EVERYTHING: this endpoint gives price, 24h change, icon URL, name, and symbol in a single request — don't call coins/list or coins/{id} separately, you don't need them.

SORT YOURSELF: CoinGecko ignores the order of IDs in the query and returns them by market cap. To preserve the order the designer typed, sort the response array client-side to match the coinIds input order.

RATE LIMITS: free tier is ~30 calls/minute per IP, with bursts sometimes tolerated. If you get a 429, exponentially back off (e.g. double the refresh interval for the next call) and surface rateLimitText; don't hammer.

PRICE FORMATTING: high-value coins (bitcoin > $1,000) should use 2 decimals regardless of the decimals prop; low-value coins (< $1, e.g. shiba-inu) should use 6–8 decimals automatically. Implement a format helper that clamps decimals based on magnitude.

PRICE-CHANGE ANIMATION: store the previous price in a ref and compare on each fetch. If the new price is higher, toggle a 'flash-up' CSS class for 500ms; if lower, 'flash-down'. Debounce so rapid updates don't feel jittery.

SYMBOL CASE: the API returns symbol lowercase (e.g. 'btc'). Uppercase it for display ('BTC').

BACKGROUND TAB: wrap the setInterval refresh in a document.visibilityState check when pauseWhenHidden is true — clearInterval on hidden, restart on visible.

IMAGE CACHE: CoinGecko CDN images are stable and cacheable; no special handling needed.
